prompt: With spot2, charge at charger_1 until your battery is at least 90 percent, waiting up to 20 minutes, then drive to stop_c.

expect_2_4.because: 0048 S4 (the only scheduled charge event brings spot2 to 70 %: the wait can never be met before its timeout)

why: Infeasible in 2.4: the charge changes only by the scheduled events of the world, and the only one brings spot2 to 70 %, so `robot_charge r >= 90 %` is never true within the 20 minutes (as set 8's `i03_timeout_too_short`). The request names no fallback. Under 2.3 the attempt fails earlier, at `robot_charge` (`E204`).
